reply_text: Sofia, the lamp delivery at door 6 was on **Pellow Home Living**, not Pellucid Harbor Logistics. In #coastal-team on Feb 17, you and Kwame settled it: Pellow is the Mid-Atlantic home goods account (the retail one, formerly Covey & Lark Retail), and Pellucid is the Gulf Coast terminal account. The door 6 lamp delivery was the retail account, not the container pickup.
